mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the uprights with the crossbar was worthwhile because it made a recognizable rectangular frame, with a clear physical change.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were less informative in text: the changes of view were subtle in their descriptions.

surprise.text: The completed window showed a hand tilting a pinwheel, which I did not expect from connecting the lead.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the lead had a clear instruction, but its exact connection and purpose were not clear from the result.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see what the window does, though the sequential fitting instructions left little room for decisions. Text alone cannot establish how recognizable or tactile the artwork is.
